name: Wish on Me
source:
A short, narrative game about Valerie, a lonely girl who was dying in her sickness. While she was alone in her gloomy room, the shooting star was seen on the sky, and then Valerie wished upon the shooting star. However, she didn't know that there were consequences behind her wishes.

[From [url=https://mohenk.itch.io/wish-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于瓦莱丽（Valerie）的简短叙事游戏，她是一个因病而濒临死亡的孤独女孩。当她独自待在阴暗的房间里时，天空中出现了流星，然后瓦莱丽向流星许愿。然而，她并不知道，她的愿望背后，却隐藏着后果。

[来自[url=https://mohenk.itch.io/wish-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
